free_tier.stated: 200,000 characters per entry (hard, enforced at API), unlimited entries, no account required. Entries kept 'forever' unless they break rules.

retention.stated: 200,000 characters per entry (hard, enforced at API), unlimited entries, no account required. Entries kept 'forever' unless they break rules

egress.terms: free direct GET, no metering; behind Cloudflare so it is CDN-cacheable at the edge.

tooling: Official Python client github.com/radude/rentry (593 stars) + pip package 'rentry'; single-file CLI with zero dependencies.
chaining: unlimited anonymous entries x 200,000 chars (~150 KB of base64 binary after the 4/3 encoder penalty). To reach 500 GB you would need ~3.5M entries, so this is a control-plane / manifest store, not a data tier — unless an unlimited free identity source is added, and even then the operator's storage is the ceiling.

limits.value: application and stated in the 400 error, so silent truncation does not happen — writes fail

limits_note: 200,000 chars per entry; custom URL 2-100 chars; edit_code required to modify; no per-account quota and no per-IP cap observed (8 rapid anonymous POSTs all returned 200); URL squatting reclaimed after 12 months idle.

reliability_note: No throttling at 8 requests/second-ish, but a 200k-character ceiling is enforced by the application and stated in the 400 error, so silent truncation does not happen — writes fail loudly. Bulk write volume is the untested risk.
